title: Inter Observer Variability Assessment through Ordered Weighted Belief Divergence Measure in MAGDM: Application to the Ensemble Classifier Feature Fusion
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a mathematical framework for Multi-Attribute Group Decision-Making (MAGDM) using belief divergence measures and applies it to the medical task of diagnosing retinal disorders. It does not contain any content related to religion, faith, theology, or ethical/moral benchmarking.
